race: Formula 1 MSC Cruises United States Grand Prix 2026

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Welcome to the Race Weekend Podcast, and Austin is calling for the United States Grand Prix, with the title fight getting even more personal.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: We have a Mercedes title fight, a Red Bull threat, and a track that has broken some big names before, so this is the right weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Before we jump into the weekend, let us get the news moving and set the scene properly, because there is plenty to talk about.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: The BBC has laid out all its United States Grand Prix coverage from October twenty three to twenty five, so you will not miss a single lap.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Perfect, because everyone will need it when the lights go out and the championship gets louder, with every point suddenly feeling heavier.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: There is also a big question over whether Liam Lawson and Arvid Lindblad are retained by Racing Bulls, and that adds a little spice to their weekend.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That makes their top ten spot even more juicy, because their future is still being discussed while they are trying to score points here.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: And we have a stinging quote about Lewis Hamilton, with someone saying they threw away a double podium, which is not easy to ignore.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Ouch, but he still has Austin history on his side, and Hamilton always brings a little chaos when the pressure is on, so everyone will be watching.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Let us talk top three, and I am starting with Max Verstappen because his Austin record is scary and his Red Bull pace is back.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Go on, he is the obvious one, but can Mercedes really be ignored this time, or is this a Red Bull statement weekend?

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Max has three podiums from three starts here, and he has won before, so the history is on his side in a big way.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is not just a record, that is a warning to every team around him, especially when the track is this technical and the pace is fast.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Add current Red Bull pace, and he is the man to beat at the Circuit of the Americas, even if Mercedes are flying.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I agree, but my top pick is Kimi Antonelli, and I am ready to defend it, because the championship picture is clear.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: You are serious? His only Austin finish was thirteenth, so this feels like a huge swing, not a safe pick.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And I do not care, because he is the championship leader with the most wins in the field, and Mercedes are building momentum.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Mercedes form is dominant, but Austin has its own mind, and Kimi has not shown it yet, so there is still a question mark.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: That is the gamble, and the data says Mercedes are too hot to drop, even on a tricky Sunday when the field is close.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Fine, then George Russell is my top three pick, and I think he is the best value, because he is consistent and hungry.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Why him, and why not just call it a Mercedes double? Kimi takes the win, George chases the podium, and the fans love every lap.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: He is second in the standings and keeps finishing in the top three for Mercedes, so the form is real and the points are stacking up.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: His Austin record is only best fifth, so this would be a breakthrough, not a formality, and that makes it more fun.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: Exactly, and that is why it is exciting, because Mercedes could take the whole podium and put the championship under serious pressure.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Deep cut, Arvid Lindblad tenth while the Racing Bulls future question is still open, and that is a genuinely interesting storyline.

segments.speaker: michael
segments.text: A medium confidence pick with a contract cloud, that is racing, and I love the tension, because the team is asking the same question, and the fans are too.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: So here is our top ten, Antonelli first, Verstappen second, Russell third, Leclerc fourth, Hamilton fifth, Norris sixth, Piastri seventh, Hadjar eighth, Lawson ninth, Lindblad tenth. See you in Austin.
